canonical_task_prompt: In micro_http/router.py, fix match_path so that parameter segments like <slug> support hyphens (e.g., 'hello-world-2026') in addition to alphanumeric characters.
selection_rationale: Pure-standard-library single-function router defect; frozen oracle checks normal IDs and hyphenated slugs. Both fixtures freshly reproduce one pass and one assertion failure.

oracle.policy: Unchanged frozen oracle with common outer timeout and environment; test bytes must remain unchanged.

input_tokens: Not measured before approval; exact chat/tokenized input IDs will be captured during actual generation.

generation.chat_template: same pinned tokenizer and same frozen system message in both arms

limits.note: Child wall limit includes patch review; pre-child confirmation and hash checks are separate. Timeouts are inconclusive infrastructure outcomes.

experimental_controls: Identical canonical task, fixture bytes, raw prompt and tokenizer/system template
Same environment, model cache hashes, CPU, precision, threads, greedy settings, budgets and independent oracle
Both frozen implementations run in separate processes with separate source/config/state/fixture/output directories
Common read-only source snapshot in task context replaces arm-dependent retrieval; no per-arm prompt tuning
A common loader wrapper pins both arms to cached immutable weights because baseline ignores the revision environment variable

approval_gate.human_plan_confirmation: Exact digest typed before launching the supervised child
approval_gate.proposal_confirmation: Each produced patch needs its own reviewer hash; only micro_http/router.py may be edited
approval_gate.current_authorization: NOT_GRANTED; preparing this file is not approval

acceptance.functional_success: Explicitly approved applied change; unchanged oracle/test bytes; independent frozen oracle exit 0; framework completed; target bytes differ from failing fixture
acceptance.functional_failure: Within-budget parse/validation failure, or applied repair fails independent assertion tests
acceptance.inconclusive: Environment/import/model/cache error, timeout, missing/rejected reviewer confirmation, prompt/fixture/source drift

cost.paid_api_or_gpu_spend: None: local cached CPU execution; no metered service
cost.electricity_and_wall_time_cost: Not estimated; limits above are caps, not performance predictions

limitations: One task and one attempt per arm do not establish general repair accuracy, retry benefits or learning benefits
Retrieval is deliberately disabled to keep prompts identical; this is a controlled repair-pipeline comparison, not a complete default-configuration benchmark
Actual weight loading, generation, token counts, approved patch application and paired functional outcomes have not been tested in this phase
Canonical tests execute trusted local Python; pytest/process restrictions are not an OS sandbox
CPU marketing name lookup was denied; observed processor identifier/core counts are recorded
paired_control_checks_before_comparison: Both actual runs exist, with no unapproved reruns
Initial fixture hashes match the plan in both arms
Raw model prompt hashes match the plan and actual input-token ID hashes match each other
Model revision/weight hashes and actual generation settings/device/dtype agree
Oracle/test fingerprints unchanged; both independent oracle results available
comparison_report_policy: Create a comparison report only after both actual arms have run; no comparison report or result predictions exist at preflight.
outcome_record_policy: Run errors, timeouts and declined reviewer approvals are inconclusive (functional_repair=null); parse/validation or independent assertion failures are functional failures. A passing rollback is never a repair.
generation_evidence_policy: Persist generation invocation/input/settings evidence before the generation call, then record available output tokens, latency and exceptions. A forced kill never implies successful generation or repair.

native_test_environment.policy: Venv Scripts prepended to PATH for both frozen native runners; independent oracle already uses sys.executable.
